A practical guide to magnetic gift boxes

FORME Packaging editorialUpdated October 21, 20263 min read

A magnetic gift box combines a rigid base with a connected cover and a concealed closure. The hinge, front flap and insert need to work together as one structure.

In this guideUnderstand the book-style structureDesign the insert around removal as well as displayChoose assembled or collapsible supplyCheck the finished sampleDiscuss your packaging →

Understand the book-style structure

In a common book-style format, the base has four rigid walls and a cover connected along the back. A front flap closes against the base, with concealed magnets aligned inside the construction. The exact cover length, spine width and closure position depend on the dimensions and wrapping build-up.

Specify the desired opening direction. An image alone may not explain which edge is hinged or where the closure sits. An empty structural sample makes it easier to inspect the hinge, wall alignment and clearance before an insert hides those details.

Design the insert around removal as well as display

A fitted tray should hold the products in the intended orientation while leaving enough access to remove them. Bottle caps, jar shoulders and accessories may require separate cavities. Ask how the tray is secured and whether the contents can move when the closed box is handled.

Paperboard partitions, molded paper and foam offer different appearances and support. Select them around the product shape and handling needs. If fabric is used, check how its thickness affects the recess dimensions and whether loose edges interfere with packing.

Choose assembled or collapsible supply

A conventional setup box retains its shape. A collapsible format uses folding panels and a corner fixing system to reduce storage volume before assembly. It needs a different sample review: erect the box, inspect diagonal corner folds, press the fixing areas and check that all walls sit square.

Confirm who will assemble the boxes and how they will be packed. A format that saves incoming volume can add work at the fulfillment stage. Include assembly instructions and the proposed outer packing in the quotation.

Check the finished sample

  • Lid opens without pulling the wrap away from the hinge.
  • Front flap meets the base evenly and stays closed as intended.
  • The insert fits within the walls without bowing them.
  • Products can be lifted out without excessive force.
  • Surface decoration clears the crease and hinge areas.

Review the box with the complete product set and any tissue or message card. Explore the magnetic box format or compare it with a lift-off structure before approving production.
